# .github/workflows/release-cloud-app-signing.yml
- Lines: 243 | Kind: protected release workflow (dispatch; sign reviewed unsigned APKs, deliver privately) | Verdict: KEEP, SIMPLIFY (move inline heredocs to scripts; merge the admit workflow in)
- Covers: admits a reviewed signing plan (via `verify-cloud-signing-input.yml`), re-stages the exact unsigned producer APKs, checks their compiled manifest and update channel against the plan using the producer commit's own `scripts/apk.ts`/`update-channel.ts`, optionally verifies an APK signing-rotation lineage, signs both variants with the protected keystore (fingerprint pinned by `android/release-signer.json`), verifies signatures and delivers via private GCS or a CMS envelope. Duplicates: keystore decode/fingerprint block also in `release-app-signing.yml:62-86`; GCP auth block ×4 across release workflows. Callers/importers: dispatch on main only, `release` environment; 3 runs. Read by `specs/quint/refinement/services/protected-app-update-promotion.mjs:14` (YAML step order), `specs/quint/services/manifest.json:2925`, `test/ci-emulator-evidence.test.mjs`, `test/qualified-app-update.test.mjs`, `test/qualified-app-update.test.py`, `scripts/ci/qualified-app-update.py`, `scripts/ci/private-artifact-identity.json` (workflow identity for admission — renaming the file changes the identity).

## Proposed end state
- Two jobs: `admit` (read-only, runs `verify-cloud-signing-input.sh`) and `sign` (release env): checkout ×2, toolchain, optional GCS auth composite, `verify-cloud-signing-input.sh --stage`, `admit-cloud-signing-apks.ts`, optional rotation verify, `with-app-keystore.sh sign-release-apks.ts`, verify + deliver script.
- ≈120 lines, no inline Node, no suffix fallback (pending owner).
